oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: infer-usw inference-pool - node flapping / kubelet restarts detected. 5xx increase & failed handshakes. Threshold breached (3x baseline). Paging oncall.
Maya Patel: saw the alert, looking. pinging Derek + Samir. any immediate customer-facing impact visible? :eyes:
Derek Chen: yup seeing spike in 5xx for chat-generation models on infer-usw. Dash shows spike at 11:02 UTC, started ~30s ago. Routing fallback not fully absorbing.
Samir Rao: pulling node list now. I think kubelet restarted on a subset after driver resets. will paste output.
Samir Rao: ```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=inference-pool=us-west
ip-10-2-3-45.us-west   NotReady  <none>   5m   v1.26.3   4 nvidia-gpu
ip-10-2-3-46.us-west   Ready     <none>  14m  v1.26.3   4 nvidia-gpu
ip-10-2-3-47.us-west   NotReady  <none>   3m   v1.26.3   4 nvidia-gpu
``` 
Samir Rao: kubelet logs show repeated `kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79` GPU resets and `kubelet: failed to start container` errors.
Maya Patel: that Xid 79 is driver GPU reset - we've seen it when driver/runtime mismatch or bad kernel module. any recent node image or driver rollout? Alok, saw any infra changes? @Alok Singh
Alok Singh: no infra rollout in past 6 hours. image builder pipeline quiet. I do see a flurry of pod evictions in ASG scale-up window at 10:57. possible noisy neighbor + oom cascade?
Derek Chen: logs from one affected pod:
Derek Chen: ```
Container: runtime-server
State: Terminated
Reason: OOMKilled
Message: "Killed process 4213 (run_server) total-vm: 1950024kB, anon-rss: 1600240kB"
```
Jess Ortiz: jumping in from eng-runtime. If nodes are losing GPU context, inference engine falls back, OOMs happen with extra memory pressure. Can we cordon the bad nodes and shift traffic? We have autoscaler warm capacity in us-west-2, but routing TTL is short.
Samir Rao: cordoning nodes now.
Samir Rao: ```
kubectl cordon ip-10-2-3-45.us-west
kubectl cordon ip-10-2-3-47.us-west
``` 
Samir Rao: draining some pods gracefully; setting pod disruption budget override for critical routes.
Maya Patel: triggering routing policy to avoid us-west AZ A for 10 minutes. Redirection to us-west-b + fallback region us-east-1. @oncall-bot please kick the traffic steer.
oncall-bot: Traffic steer initiated: prefer regions [us-west-b, us-east-1] for inference requests from impacted routes. TTL 10m. :white_check_mark:
Derek Chen: start scaling up warm capacity in us-west-b by 20% and increase concurrent queues to reduce backpressure.
Alok Singh: starting node reprovisioning for the two NotReady nodes; running driver reinstall + kernel module reload. I'll also collect dmesg and nvidia-smi logs.
Alok Singh: ```
$ dmesg | tail -n 50
[  12.345678] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79
[  12.345679] NVRM: GPU lockup - switching to recovery
```
Maya Patel: customer impact: Support shows ~18% of requests for model gpt-redwood-medium returned 5xx or timeouts for customers on us-west region between 11:02-11:06. Not widespread but several mid-tier customers flagged latency. tagging support.
support-bot: Creating incident ticket INC-2026-1193, severity P2; adding affected customers list. Notifying CSM.
Jess Ortiz: mitigation plan: 1) cordon/drain bad nodes (done). 2) reprovision with driver reinstall (in progress). 3) increase routing ring to fallback model-lite in case of sustained capacity loss. 4) if driver resets persist, roll back kernel/driver last change (none recorded) or quarantine node image. Also gather crashstack and heap profile from runtime.
Derek Chen: reducing batch sizes and enforcing per-request token cap on active routes to lower memory pressure. Patching runtime config now.
Derek Chen: ```
PATCH /configs/runtime
{
  "default_batch_size": 8,
  "max_tokens_per_request": 1024
}
```
Samir Rao: nodes reprovision returned to Ready at 11:09 after driver reinstall. nvml shows no Xid for last 3 minutes. rejoining pool.
Samir Rao: ```
kubectl uncordon ip-10-2-3-45.us-west
kubectl uncordon ip-10-2-3-47.us-west
``` 
Maya Patel: monitoring latency and 5xx; initial trend is down, but we'll keep traffic steer for 5m cooldown. Please collect heap/kv cache stats from runtime for the drained pods and attach to the ticket.
Alok Singh: uploaded logs to /artifacts/3765432101/ (dmesg, nvidia-smi, kubelet logs). Added brief note: possible client workload pattern triggered kernel GPU reset; investigating power/cooling logs with infra team.
Jess Ortiz: QA: confirm no model degradation on rerouted traffic. Also schedule a brief postmortem if we see similar resets in next 24h. Recommend adding explicit GPU driver health probe to alert earlier.
Maya Patel: handoff: Derek, can you take second-watch and follow up with infra tomorrow? I'll stay on for 10 more minutes then hand off to Samir for oncall continuity.
Derek Chen: ack. I'll monitor for an hour, keep scaling policy open. Samir, you'll pick up 20:00 UTC handoff?
Samir Rao: ack, I'll take the night handover at 20:00 UTC. leaving runbook notes in the ticket: actions performed, commands, artifacts path.
Maya Patel: thanks all. Incident reduced. keeping P2 until 11:30 UTC for verification. Closing initial paging thread. :small_blue_diamond:
oncall-bot: Incident severity updated: P2 -> Monitoring. Logged timeline and participants. Ticket INC-2026-1193 updated.
